correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers are explicit. Conditional edge counting yields the exact exponential-potential drift; geometric series prove nonnegativity for all positive fitnesses and strict positivity for a mixed group of size at least three. Connectivity supplies finite absorption and a positive-probability route to such a group from every mixed state. Optional stopping proves both inequality directions and the occupation identity; the neutral count martingale gives equality at r=1. A separately run exact rational Markov-chain solver reproduces 330 finite comparisons and 294 edge-defect instances. The finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The claim proves, rather than recomputes, a phenomenon highlighted numerically in the 2023 motivating paper. Its all-size weighted and mixed-rank generality isolates incident-weight balance and whole-group replacement as a structural suppressor mechanism. The exact nonnegative occupation-defect identity explains strictness and the sharp pairwise-only equality boundary, making the theorem useful for comparing group-update population models.
